 Dakota Fanning and Elle Fanning Share the Screen for the First Time as Sisters in Dramatic “The Nightingale” Trailer
 ‘The Nightingale,’ which has been in the works since 2019, marks the first time Dakota and Elle have ever starred in the same movie
 People Follow Tommy McArdle Add to Preferred Sources Thu, November 19, 2026 at 2:56 PM UTC NEED TO KNOW
 Dakota and Elle Fanning are playing sisters on the big screen in their new movie The Nightingale 
 The World War II-set drama marks the first time Dakota and Elle have worked together, despite decades spent in the industry
 The Nightingale , based on author Kristin Hannah's 2015 novel of the same name, is in theaters March 19, 2027
 At long last, Dakota Fanning and her sister Elle Fanning are starring in the same movie.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement On Thursday, Nov. 19, Sony Pictures released the trailer for the Fanning sisters' new film The Nightingale , a World War II-set drama adapted from author Kristin Hannah's best-selling 2015 novel . In the movie, Dakota, 32, and Elle, 28, portray a pair of French sisters named Vianne and Isabelle, respectively.
 The movie sees both sisters confronted with the realities of France's occupation by Nazi Germany during the 1940s and follows each of their paths throughout the war.
 Dakota Fanning and Elle Fanning in 'The Nightingale' 
 Credit: Sony Pictures/Youtube 
 "The Nightingale stars real-life sisters Elle and Dakota Fanning together onscreen for the first time in the powerful, emotional story of two sisters forced to embark on separate courageous, dangerous paths in a fight for survival and freedom during World War II," per the official synopsis.
 The movie also stars Mark Rylance , Edmund Donovan, Shira Haas, Albrecht Schuch, Douglas Hodge, Gwilym Lee and Vinette Robinson.
 Advertisement Advertisement Dakota and Elle were attached to star in The Nightingale as early as 2019, with French actress Mélanie Laurent set to direct. The COVID-19 pandemic forced the project back several years. Michael Morris ( Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy ) stepped in to direct, and author Hannah shared on her Instagram page that the movie began filming on March 28.
 Dakota Fanning and Elle Fanning in 'The Nightingale' 
 Credit: Sony Pictures/Youtube 
 "The Nightingale  will be the first time we act on screen together," Elle and Dakota said in a statement to  The Hollywood Reporter when the project was first announced. "We have played the same character at different ages but have never spoken to each other in front of a camera. For years, we have looked for a film to do with one another and then this gem appeared."
 In a first look interview with Vanity Fair published Wednesday, Nov. 18, the sisters shared that their grandmother told them they would be a perfect pair to star after she read Hannah's initial novel.
 VIPs Get More
 "Vianne shows her love through nurture and cooking and taking care of a home. Elle's character, Isabelle, is the more obviously daring one that runs towards danger and adventure," Dakota told the outlet. "I do think that we are truly probably the people to play these roles because we deeply understand that dynamic. We inhabit some of the same qualities."
 Advertisement Advertisement "I think we're going to have to be fellow actors on set. But of course, we are playing sisters in the film that we're going to be working on together," Elle told PEOPLE of how she and Dakota would approach the movie back in November 2025, noting that " we have to bring a little bit of that " sisterly energy to the big screen as well.

 The Nightingale is in theaters March 19, 2027. For now, Elle appears on the big screen in The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping , while Dakota most recently starred in the Prime Video romance The Sun Never Sets .
